text: Mr Alvarez located the terrier. Mara said, “I want to thank Mr Alvarez.” Toby told Mara, “I want a dog biscuit.” Toby borrowed the dog cutter. Mara and Toby pulled the last dough lump. The last dough lump was torn. Mara said, “I can share the last dough lump.” She rejoined the last dough lump. Toby guided the dog cutter. She pressed the dog cutter. She handed Toby the star cutter. Toby pressed the star cutter on the dog biscuit. Grandma baked the dog biscuit. The dog biscuit cooled. Toby returned the dog cutter to the cutter tin. Mara put the dog biscuit in the blue tin. Mr Alvarez lifted the dog biscuit. The dog biscuit's star shone.
